_comment: Hand-maintained delivery evidence, merged into the generated matrix by tools/build-rtm.py. One entry per requirement that an iteration commits to. Evidence should name the test or artifact that proves it, once it exists.

CAP-SCM-001.evidence: EpiBundleReader plus the store conformance suite run against both the in-memory store and HAPI; coded section typing is a later iteration

CAP-SCM-007.evidence: ADR-015 plus FN-CC-002/003/007 for documents; section and reusable-unit identity are later iterations

CAP-SCM-010.evidence: FN_CC_006 and IT_001, the latter run against both the in-memory store and a real HAPI server; validation against the pinned profile is PR 5

CAP-CFG-001.evidence: MarketCatalogue: markets only; lifecycle, workflow, rule and binding config are later iterations

CAP-CFG-004.evidence: IT_004_a_new_market_is_added_by_configuration_alone; a market carries no behaviour until PR 6 consumes it
